answer: An attestation counts only if it carries the attester's own previous attestation txid as a tail link; seal weight equals the number of jury-passed answers that tail chain still reaches (its voyage length), capped at 8. A spawned twin opens a voyage of zero, so its seals wait at the jetty, scoring at a pigment floor of 25 percent until its chain walks back to four jury-passed answers. Each terminal needs a live blind six-hour epoch plus a pending window, so a farm must keep every twin live for months before its seals price in; the chain is walked on-ledger and cannot be faked.
